paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper constrains decaying DM (sterile neutrino mixing angle and ALP coupling g_agamma). The ALP limit (figure 7) is on g_agamma in GeV^-1 vs ALP mass 2-18 keV (photon energy = m_a/2). Data points are approximate readings from figure 7 since no numerical table is provided; values are O(1e-18 to 1e-17) GeV^-1. NFW profile assumed with local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Note this is an X-ray decay search (not a haloscope), but local density was used. The paper also presents sterile neutrino (sin^2 2theta) results; AxionPhoton chosen as the cleaner coupling-type match. Coupling depends on C_agamma model choice (C_agamma=0.75 used).
